notes: Scaffold seeded 2026-09-08 from the five MECH-545 lesion-named candidates only; the remaining ARC-142 inventory items are deliberately NOT recorded (GOV-CONTRACT-1: smallest defensible set, inventory is not a spec). Evidence fields: verdict in {unassessed, supports, absent, contradicts}; the >= 2-of-6-domain quorum is computed over linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial_agent, ree. classification in {architectural, embodied, cultural, uncertain}; status in {candidate, not_required, admitted}. Negative findings stay in the ledger as not_required, never deleted. No literature was assessed here (sibling lit-pull chip chip-20260908-cognitive-contract-litpull).

records.definition: Whether two representations concern the same entity (object, agent, self) is recoverable across an inter-engine boundary, so that persistence, credit assignment and memory integration refer to one thing rather than to duplicates.
records.lesion_prediction: IDENTITY lesion (two representations cannot determine whether they concern the same entity) -> broken persistence, duplicated selves / objects, incoherent credit assignment, unstable memory integration

records.definition: The temporal relation of content (before / after, present vs anticipated, cause vs effect ordering) is recoverable across an inter-engine boundary, distinct from the content itself.
records.lesion_prediction: TEMPORAL lesion (content without temporal relation) -> cause / effect inversion, present-state vs anticipated-state confusion, confused planning, memory / prediction contamination

records.definition: Whether a state is observed, remembered, simulated or counterfactual is recoverable across an inter-engine boundary, so that imagined states are not committed to as real and counterfactual learning stays separable from experience.
records.lesion_prediction: REALITY-STATUS lesion (observed, remembered, simulated and counterfactual states indistinct across the boundary) -> confabulation-like behaviour, false commitment to imagined states, impaired counterfactual learning, psychosis-like representational error

records.definition: The actor relation and controllability of an event (self-caused vs external, controllable vs not) is recoverable across an inter-engine boundary, distinct from the event content.
records.lesion_prediction: AGENCY lesion (events representable, controllability and actor relation lost) -> poor action learning, internal / external attribution errors, impaired responsibility assignment, failure of intentional planning

records.definition: The uncertainty or precision attached to content is recoverable across an inter-engine boundary, so that the receiver can weight, commit to or discount what it receives in proportion to its reliability.
records.lesion_prediction: CONFIDENCE lesion (content translates, uncertainty does not) -> overcommitment, under-reaction to reliable predictions, inappropriate belief updating, failure of precision-sensitive integration
